description: Utility functions for map interactions in the Thingsboard UI, including tooltip creation, polygon and coordinate validation, and label parsing.

methods.name: createTooltip
methods.description: Creates and binds a tooltip popup to a map layer with configurable behavior based on user interaction.

methods.name: bindPopupActions
methods.description: Binds custom action handlers to elements within a popup.

methods.name: isCutPolygon
methods.description: Determines if the provided data represents a polygon that has been cut.

methods.name: isJSON
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid JSON and not an array.

methods.name: entitiesParseName
methods.description: Parses entity names for display, optionally using a custom label function.

methods.name: isValidLatitude
methods.description: Validates if a value is a proper latitude.

methods.name: isValidLongitude
methods.description: Validates if a value is a proper longitude.

methods.name: isValidLatLng
methods.description: Validates if latitude and longitude are valid coordinates.
